structure.what_is_said: Hands are noticed when you greet someone, hold a coffee or gesture; not perfect hands, well-groomed ones: clean, shaped nails, soft moisturised skin; keep hand cream in your handbag; natural, gel, acrylic or extensions all look elegant when neat; favourites: milky white, French ombre, classic French tips, pearl white with a subtle chrome finish, the classic red manicure; timeless and versatile.

structure.what_is_said: Flawless skin is not the essence of elegance; filters and edited feeds make it seem standard; acne scars, hyperpigmentation, texture and fine lines don't detract from beauty; a healthy, well-groomed complexion is more timeless than perfection; basics: SPF daily, moisturising, removing makeup before bed, a simple routine; confidence comes from taking care of yourself.

tricks.q: 2. How a point opens and closes
tricks.answer: Open: the last shot dissolves (usually through white) to a WHITE/CARD with '<n>. <Title>' in black script, written on, held about 3-4 s (0:38, 1:29, 2:42, 3:50, 4:45, 5:29, 6:12, 7:01, 7:45, 8:23). The narrator does not read the title; the card sits under the point's first sentence, which is often a riddle or observation ('One of the most elegant features of a woman is not something you can see' under '2. Have A Signature Fragrance'; 'One thing I've noticed about elegant women is that they...' under cards 8 and 9). After the card the first picture is FULL (0:42, 1:32, 3:53, 4:48, 5:32, 7:04, 7:49, 8:26) or caramel (2:46, 6:15). Close: many points end on a text line that repeats the spoken moral: on caramel ('True elegance isn't about adding more...', 1:23-1:28; 'Elegance isn't always about what you're wearing...', 5:22-5:28), on white ('The most memorable part of your presence / is the one nobody can see.', 2:37-2:41; 'Elegance isn't about / spending more', 8:16-8:18) or across a row ('A well-cared-for smile has a way of leaving / a lasting impression.', 6:56-6:59).

Normal: 2-5 s per picture; rows change a panel every 1-2 s while building. Long single-clip holds: Breakfast at Tiffany's tooth-brushing about 15 s (6:27-6:42); DIY lip-scrub tutorial about 13 s (6:43-6:55); headscarf tutorial about 12 s (9:17-9:28); GRWM SPF reel about 11 s beside the checklist (4:28-4:39); product line-up about 9 s (8:39-8:47); To Catch a Thief Grace Kelly about 7 s (8:52-8:58); hotel-bed hand cream about 6 s (3:08-3:13); steamer about 6 s (5:10-5:15); newspaper/robe about 6 s (7:39-7:44); hair-tousle bob about 6 s (9:09-9:14).

3 panels with thin orange/caramel (sometimes white or cream) gutters, edge to edge. They build one panel at a time: 0:08-0:10 (hair-tying, lipstick, robe), 1:46-1:47, 2:46-2:48, 3:27-3:29 (one nail style per spoken name), 3:58-3:59, 5:40-5:42 (Audrey, Diana, Grace Kelly exactly on each name), 7:07-7:08, 8:12-8:13, 9:16-9:17. A moving tutorial or GRWM clip often sits in the centre while the sides stay still (7:08-7:12 'LIPS AND CURLS', 9:17-9:28 headscarf), or the centre swaps item by item on a spoken list (7:24-7:29 candle / music / slowing down). tricks.q: Hair/grooming moments (for 'Why Her Hair Always Looks Expensive')
tricks.answer: Hair is never a point here, but hair shots carry the mood throughout: Grace Kelly smoothing her hair in a convertible, used to open AND close the video (0:00-0:02, 8:52-8:58); a long dark-hair flip reel (0:03-0:07); a woman tying her hair up from behind, opening the first row (0:08-0:11); a half-up ponytail swinging in a closet during the guide pitch (0:34-0:37); Audrey's short fringe and Diana's feathered short hair named as signature looks ('Princess Diana's hairstyle' = Diana waving, 5:41; two more Diana hair photos 5:49-5:53); Audrey's sleep mask over a messy updo (6:27-6:42); the GRWM reel ending with the woman releasing her claw clip and shaking her hair out (4:38-4:39); a hand through the hair with sunglasses on the head (4:42); 'LIPS AND CURLS': an older woman brushing out big silver curls and spraying them (7:08-7:12); a salon on 'haircut' (7:53-7:55); a bow claw clip being put in at a mirror (8:12-8:15); hairbrush, wide-tooth comb and hair ties in the carry line-up (8:39-8:47); a sleek ponytail touch-up with sunglasses (8:48-8:51); a short wavy bob tousled under the part-two ask (9:09-9:14); a headscarf tied over the hair (9:17-9:28). Sleek buns and slick-backed hair are the default look of the models (0:22, 2:09, 3:08, 8:59, 9:29).
